entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Ferdows, also known as the Jāmeh Mosque of Tun and the Jāmeh Mosque of Toon, is a Sunni Friday mosque (jāmeh), located in the center of the town of Toon, in the city of Ferdows, in the province of South Khorasan, Iran.
